decisions.reason: As the flagship platform, its option value is central to the firm's integrated geospatial strategy and it has shown sufficient commitment to justify keeping it open.
Mobile field data capture remains a complementary option with uncertain but not yet negative prospects and likely low incremental cost, so it is worth keeping open.
The search extension is a low-cost component option that may still add value to the platform, and its prospects have not resolved enough to abandon it.
